parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "area": $json.alertLog.areaName,
  "hazard": $json.alertLog.hazard,
  "riskScore": $json.riskScore,
  "riskLevel": $json.severity,
  "commanderName": $json.commander.name,
  "commanderEmail": $json.commander.email,
  "forecastWindow": $json.riskForecast.forecastWindow || "Next 24 hours",
  "contributingFactors": $json.riskForecast.contributingFactors || [
    "Severe precipitation detected",
    "High inundation risk in lowlands",
    "Population density exposure"
  ],
  "recommendedAction": "Review evacuation response plan. For CRITICAL alerts: Commander review is required before simulated emergency execution. Emergency execution still requires human approval.",
  "isTest": false,
  "workflow": "RESQNET Risk Alert"
}

={
  "service": "RESQNET_RISK_MONITOR_SYNC",
  "workflow": "RESQNET Risk Alert",
  "alertId": $json.alertId,
  "area": $json.area,
  "severity": $json.severity,
  "riskScore": $json.riskScore,
  "commander": $json.commander,
  "requiresCommanderReview": $json.evaluation.requiresCommanderReview,
  "emergencyExecutionStatus": $json.evaluation.emergencyExecutionStatus,
  "safeguardNotice": "Require commander review before simulated emergency execution. The email may notify the commander, but emergency execution still requires human approval.",
  "timestamp": $json.timestamp,
  "simulationMode": $json.simulationMode
}

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "workflow": "RESQNET Risk Alert",
  "status": "DISPATCHED",
  "alertId": $json.alertId,
  "severity": $json.severity,
  "riskScore": $json.riskScore,
  "area": $json.area,
  "commander": $json.commander,
  "emailDispatched": true,
  "resqnetUpdated": true,
  "emergencyExecution": {
    "requiresCommanderReview": $json.evaluation.requiresCommanderReview,
    "status": $json.evaluation.emergencyExecutionStatus,
    "policy": "For CRITICAL alerts: Require commander review before simulated emergency execution. The email may notify the commander, but emergency execution still requires human approval."
  },
  "timestamp": new Date().toISOString()
}

={
  "success": true,
  "workflow": "RESQNET Risk Alert",
  "status": "SKIPPED",
  "severity": $json.severity,
  "riskScore": $json.riskScore,
  "area": $json.area,
  "emailDispatched": false,
  "reason": $json.skipReason,
  "timestamp": new Date().toISOString()
}
